title: Modernization choices should protect useful capability and target evidenced constraints.
modernization_practice_1: Choose business outcomes before technology decisions.
Compare opportunities by value, complexity, and risk.
modernization_practice_2: Evolve can organize code evidence for review.
Evolve connects findings to planning tools.
AI can support analysis across the lifecycle
while people validate findings and decisions.
modernization_practice_3: Pair product, engineering, and operations owners.
Plan for support and ongoing ownership.
modernization_practice_4: Stage changes around dependencies and service risk.
modernization_practice_5: Tie investment to a clear outcome.
modernization_practice_6: Choose a path suited to system needs.
Keep useful capability where evidence supports it.
modernization_practice_8: Plan for ownership and knowledge transfer.
